## Where I am
Implemented the Dashboards v2 grid on `tom/dashboard-grid-v2` with `react-grid-layout`: drag/resize, per-user layout persisted server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (GET `/dashboards/:id` returns `layout`), localStorage fallback on failure, everything behind the `dashboards_v2` flag. Widget sizing uses a `ResizeObserver` hook setting `data-size` (sm/md/lg at 320/480px), compatible with iOS 15. `DashboardTile` was renamed to `WidgetCard` (deprecated re-export kept so v1 `DashboardList` still compiles). Storybook CSS resolution fixed in `.storybook/preview.ts` + `optimizeDeps.include`. Tests, lint and typecheck pass; Storybook build passes. Draft PR #418 opened, last commit `d2286a0`.

- [in-progress] UX review by Priya on the Zest iPad (iOS 15) — widgets previously didn't resize due to unsupported container queries, now fixed but unverified on device.
- [next-step] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only via the flags admin (no code change), before the demo on Tuesday the 24th.
- [next-step] Keep v1 dashboards available behind the flag until January (source: t15).
- [failed-attempt] Container queries (`@container`) — ignored by iOS 15 Safari; all `@container` rules and `container-type` were removed in favour of the single ResizeObserver system (source: t09).
- [failed-attempt] First Storybook build failed with `Cannot find module 'react-grid-layout/css/styles.css'`; fixed by importing the CSS in `.storybook/preview.ts`.
- [failed-attempt] Initial DashboardGrid snapshot test failed due to new react-grid-layout wrapper divs; updated with `-u`.
- [question] Whether server-side layout persistence should also be validated against the endpoint already in `main` (not yet confirmed).
- [decision] Server-side layout persistence via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (source: t03).
- [decision] Use container queries for widget scaling, then replace with a ResizeObserver hook and drop container queries entirely (source: t05, t09).
- [decision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard` everywhere (source: t11).
- [decision] Open the PR as draft, review by Priya (source: t17).
- [decision] Flag `dashboards_v2` on for the Zest workspace only for the Tuesday 24th demo; no removal of old dashboards now (source: t15).
